name: Open Face Herby Egg Salad English Muffins with Lemony Roast Asparagus

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 220°C (425°F) and arrange rack in the upper third of the oven. Line a large baking sheet pan with aluminum foil and set aside.
Place eggs in a large pot, cover with water, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook for 8 minutes. Drain hot water and add ice or run under cold water to cool; set aside.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 small bunches asparagus
1 small bunch fresh dill
1 small pkg chives
2 sticks celery
1 lemon

instructions.primary_message: Snap (or cut) off woody ends of the asparagus. Transfer to the baking sheet, drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper. Toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, turning asparagus halfway through, until tender-crisp, 5-8 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place half in a medium bowl. (Reserve remaining dill for serving.)
Chop chives into small pieces. Add half to the bowl with the dill. (Reserve remaining chives for serving.)
Trim and small dice celery. Add to the bowl along with mayo, capers, Dijon, salt, and pepper, then stir to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup mayonnaise
2 tbsp capers
2 tsp Dijon mustard
½ tsp black pepper
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Peel and roughly chop the eggs. Add to the bowl with the dressing and gently stir to combine the egg salad. Set aside.
When the asparagus is done, change oven to broil on high. (Skip this step if you are using a toaster for the English muffins.)

Carefully remove cooked asparagus from the baking sheet by lifting the corners of the foil and transferring the whole sheet to a flat surface. (Skip this step if you are using a toaster for the English muffins.)
Split muffins and arrange on the baking sheet. Place in the oven and broil until toasted, about 1 minute per side; remove from oven. (Alternatively, you can use a toaster for the muffins.)
Meanwhile, zest and juice lemon into a small bowl. Add oil, Dijon, salt, and pepper, then stir to combine the sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tsp Dijon mustard
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide muffins and asparagus between plates. Top muffins with egg salad and reserved herbs. Drizzle asparagus with lemony sauce and enjoy!
